node.title: Re^2: Qualified package variable access
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
that's the first time I've used 'our' as far as I recall. My very well thumbed O'Reilly camel book (2nd edition 1996!) doesn't actually mention it!

[doc://our] was [doc://perl56delta#"our"-declarations|added in Perl 5.6], released in March 2000. Before that, one of the ways "predeclare" package variables was the [doc://vars] pragma. You might be interested in the [https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/programming-perl-4th/9781449321451/|4th edition Camel], or [http://modernperlbooks.com/books/modern_perl_2016/|Modern Perl].
